Show "Collect {0}" when you right-click a water container: pours {0} from your water sources until the container is full, going by the actual water quality in each container.
Collect from Moisture Farms
Every Moisture Farm in your shop, including ones in boxes. Broken ones don't count.
Collect from Water Purifiers
Goes by the water's current quality, so water still being purified is taken too.
Collect from Hydroponic Systems

The container in the water slot of Hydroponic Systems. Pick which ones:
Off = none
Hydroreed = ones growing Hydroreed (perennial ones too)
Hydroreed (incl. harvested) = also ones just harvested, with an empty seed slot but Hydroreed Seeds in Produce Output
Pinned = ones whose water slot container is pinned (right-click > Pin; any crop, or empty)
All = every Hydroponic System (any crop, or empty)
Hydroponics minimum quality

The Hydroponic Systems picked above are only collected from once their water reaches this quality (Ghostwater still being purified is never taken).\nAlso turn on the matching water under Right-click menu.
Collect from Evaporators
The container in an Evaporator's Distillate slot; the one in its Container slot is never taken.\nGoes by the water's actual quality; also turn on the matching water under Right-click menu.
Collect from the Vending Fountain
All three tanks, including Moisture Farms and Water Purifiers placed there. Water you set aside to sell will be taken.
Collect from Fridges
Both the Chill Zone and the Freeze Zone.
Collect from containers in the inventory
Water containers in the inventory, boxes and so on that aren't inside a machine.
Collect from containers in the Display Case
Water containers in the Display Case that aren't inside a machine.
Collect from containers in the Trash Can
Water containers in the Trash Can that aren't inside a machine.
